I added `GET /api/v1/items/stats`. I haven't run the tests or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been exercised.

It returns `{"count": n, "newest_title": str | null}`. For a normal user it covers only their own items. For a superuser it covers all items. The newest item is picked by `created_at`, with `id` as a tie-break, and `newest_title` is `null` when there are no items.

- **Query:** `get_item_stats` in `backend/app/crud.py` runs the count and newest-title queries, so the route handler never touches the session directly.
- **Route:** `read_item_stats` in `backend/app/api/routes/items.py` sits above `/{id}`, so `stats` isn't parsed as an item id.
- **Response model:** `ItemStats` is in `backend/app/models.py`.

I did not regenerate the frontend API client, which `docs/api.md` says to commit after endpoint changes. Run `bash scripts/generate-client.sh` for that. I also didn't add tests or update the notes folder.
